sections.title: Provocateurs: Feminists Onstage
sections.description: What is feminist theatre? How do artists use live performance to provoke social, political, and personal change? This course will examine a wide array of feminist plays and performances from the late twentieth century to the present moment, and will include viewing of both live and recorded productions, as well as the opportunity for students to create their own artistic provocations. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
